item.title: Houston's Cinco De Mayo parade canceled this year amid ICE concerns, LULAC says
item.description: The Cinco De Mayo Parade, held annually in downtown Houston, has been canceled this year amid rising concerns of ICE enforcement activity, LULAC said.

item.title: Some question why murder suspect was released from Harris County Jail
item.description: A murder suspect was allowed to walk out of the Harris County Jail hours before or after a murder charge was filed against him, depending on whose account you believe.

item.title: Disaster as fencing wire gets tangled in spinning car wash in North Carolina
item.description: The first rule of going to the car wash with your truck is make sure there's nothing in the bed. A North Carolina man found that out the hard way.

item.title: US and Israel launch joint strike in Iran, US official says
item.description: Israel and the US have launched a joint attack on Iran, officials say. President Trump confirmed the US military began "major combat operations."

item.title: What to know about US-Israel attacks on Iran
item.description: The attacks came a day after Trump voiced frustration over lack of progress in negotiations to stop Iran's ability to develop nuclear weapons.

item.title: Man killed in deadly shooting in Alief area, according to Houston Police Department
item.description: Houston police said officers arrived at the scene and found the man shot to death in a parking lot outside of a business in the Alief area.

item.title: 2 elderly residents killed in Magnolia home fire, according to fire department officials
item.description: According to the Magnolia Fire Department, two elderly residents did not make it out and died in the house fire early Saturday morning.

item.title: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, Iran's supreme leader, is dead, Trump says
item.description: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, 86, the supreme leader of Iran, was killed in the U.S.-Israeli attack on the country Saturday, President Donald Trump said.

item.title: 2026 Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo Parade rolls through downtown, celebrating Western heritage
item.description: The 2026 Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo Parade marked the official start of rodeo season, with people gathering in downtown to celebrate Western heritage and culture.

item.title: Fog returns Sunday morning, sunny and quiet until stormy pattern returns next week
item.description: Aside from some morning fog, the weekend weather looks great, but next week storm chances return to Southeast Texas.
